title: HoloMobInfo Addon: Curios
description: Curios addon for HoloMobInfo that requires a spyglass equipped in a Curios slot to view mob panels.
body:
This is a compatibility mod, a bridge between 2 mods: [HoloMobInfo](https://modrinth.com/mod/holomobinfo) and [Curios(Forge\NeoForge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios).

**You need both HoloMobInfo and Curios installed or the addon will not work.**


## Features

- Curios-based access check for HoloMobInfo mob panels.
- Requires a spyglass equipped in the Curios `spyglass` slot to view mob panels.
